name: Tamsin the Kite-maker
conversations: Oh! A visitor. Mind the paper, it's drying. Well. It's been drying for three weeks.
I keep making kites. Twelve this month. Not one of them has left the ground.
A kite needs only two things: a good tail and a bit of sky that wants to play.
The sky doesn't want to play anymore. I don't blame it. Nobody does, lately.
My gran said the first Leafwind kite was flown as a thank-you. To the Great Tree, I think.
Thank you for what, she never said. I wish I'd asked.
If the wind ever comes back, the first kite is yours. The yellow one. It's the bravest.
